node.title: Post-strip affine-pencil charge
node.statement: Under the affine-core charge hypotheses, assume distinct selected errors have common zero set at most kappa<=k. For each kernel basis T used by two slopes, its persistent set completes T to their exact common zero set, so p_T+a<=kappa. The all-zero incidence then gives M_T<=floor((n-kappa)/(k+h-kappa)) and |P|C(h+a,a)<=C(n,a)floor((n-kappa)/(k+h-kappa)). The post-strip high-core branch uses kappa=k and the low-core branch uses kappa=k-1. Exact XR arithmetic pays selector ranks 4,4,4,15,15,14.
